description: A production script's row in testicle.db's script table: {name, hash, deleted, changed}. name is the script, scoped to run://. A script with no rows yet gets its script row and a suite row, flagged needs testing, for every suite that concerns it, as a change would make them. A name that is no production script answers the error "not a production script"; a production script that is not there, "no such file". It was file.get until the table file was renamed script.
